test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train travelling at a speed of 36 km/h crosses a pole in 24 sec. What is the length of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 36 km/h

Time taken to cross the pole = 24 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Length of the train = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Convert speed to m/s:

Speed = 36 km/h = (36 × 1000) / (60 × 60) m/s

⇒ Speed = 10 m/s

Calculate the length of the train:

Length = Speed × Time

⇒ Length = 10 × 24

⇒ Length = 240 m

**The length of the train is 240 meters.**
